issues.text: Robots page at 1280 and 1440: the 3-column card grid leaves cards with large empty areas (R-06 Titan, R-05 Nano), while cards are uneven in height. Second-row cards are cut off with the Contrôle row missing at 1280, so the page is very long.
Small, low-contrast secondary text (KPI sublabels, 'Pour atteindre…' captions, table cells, tier filter pills) is hard to read, especially in the downscaled 1440 view.

Progress bar colors vary across cards without a legend (R-04 Chassis is blue, others are red or orange). The R-03 and R-02 cards have different header structures (status pill above the ring vs. beside it), so the card tops do not align.

The Hexa robot page has several equally weighted cards below the alert. The key blocker (the 2 critical repairs) and the next step are not emphasized beyond the banner, and the primary button stays generic.

Robot ring scores show 6/15/21 while the cards' sub-scores read 18-52, and R-03/R-02/R-01 rings show 0, which looks inconsistent with the 'Score moyen 45'. The sort claim 'du plus bas au plus haut' does not match the ring values.
The Hexa page tables use width well, but the 'Ce qui bloque' column is truncated with an ellipsis ('IM-109 en imp…'), cutting off content.

critic.summary: A coherent, realistic workshop dashboard with a clear robot-fleet and detail structure, but dense small text, uneven card layouts with empty space, a truncated table cell and inconsistent score data pull it below the pass bar.
